properties.bedrock_lithology: Carboniferous sedimentary strata, sandstone and siltstone bedrock
properties.quarried_materials: Craigleith and Hailes pale buff sandstone ashlar, Scottish slate
properties.groundwater_drainage: Sloping urban glacial till over bedrock, moderate natural runoff

properties.primary_surfacing: Traditional whinstone and granite mews setts, sandstone kerbstones, paved flagstones
properties.micro_grading: Gradual downward slope along Charlotte Lane and Hope Street Lane toward the northwest
properties.wear_patina: Historic cart and tire smoothing along central lanes, weathered drainage gullies

properties.understory: Occasional domestic courtyard climbing shrubs and potted perennials
properties.foliage_density: Sparse urban foliage restricted to private rear tenement garden courts

properties.typology: Edinburgh New Town Georgian townhouses, curved circus terraces, and utilitarian mews lanes with vernacular revival corner structures

structures.name: Corner Arts & Crafts / Vernacular Structure (19 Charlotte Lane)
structures.roof_geometry: Steeply pitched red tile roof with prominent red brick/terracotta chimneys and gabled dormers
structures.facade_material: Exposed timber framing with white infill over ashlar stone ground floor
structures.weathering_patina: Subtle urban soot accumulation along timber joints and chimney stacks

structures.name: Charlotte Square and West End Georgian Terraces
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Scottish slate roofs with continuous dormer windows and stone chimneystacks
structures.facade_material: Fine Craigleith pale buff ashlar sandstone with rusticated lower levels
structures.weathering_patina: Historic urban soot patina and clean Georgian masonry lines

structures.name: Charlotte Lane Mews Range
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched slate roofs with flush rooflights and stone coped gables
structures.facade_material: Rubble sandstone with dressed ashlar quoins and timber coachhouse openings
structures.weathering_patina: Moderate surface mineral staining and authentic mortar repointing

properties.sky_condition: Clean standard midday daylight with distinct directional shadows
